owner_profiles_text_length_check.name: owner_profiles_text_length_check
owner_profiles_text_length_check.value: ("owner_profiles"."first_name" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."first_name") <= 100) and ("owner_profiles"."last_name" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."last_name") <= 100) and ("owner_profiles"."legal_name" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."legal_name") <= 200) and ("owner_profiles"."phone" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."phone") <= 20) and ("owner_profiles"."address_line" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."address_line") <= 200) and ("owner_profiles"."city" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."city") <= 100) and ("owner_profiles"."postal_code" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."postal_code") <= 12)

parking_hours_exceptions_period_check.name: parking_hours_exceptions_period_check
parking_hours_exceptions_period_check.value: ("parking_hours_exceptions"."opens_minute" is null) = ("parking_hours_exceptions"."closes_minute" is null) and ("parking_hours_exceptions"."opens_minute" is null or ("parking_hours_exceptions"."opens_minute" >= 0 and "parking_hours_exceptions"."closes_minute" <= 1440 and "parking_hours_exceptions"."opens_minute" < "parking_hours_exceptions"."closes_minute" and "parking_hours_exceptions"."opens_minute" % 30 = 0 and "parking_hours_exceptions"."closes_minute" % 30 = 0))

parking_locations_status_email_idx.name: parking_locations_status_email_idx
parking_locations_status_email_idx.where: "parking_locations"."owner_id" is not null and "parking_locations"."status" in ('in_review', 'changes_requested', 'published') and "parking_locations"."notified_status" is distinct from "parking_locations"."status"

parking_locations_complete_check.name: parking_locations_complete_check
parking_locations_complete_check.value: "parking_locations"."status" in ('draft', 'changes_requested') or ("parking_locations"."name" is not null and "parking_locations"."address" is not null and "parking_locations"."area_id" is not null and "parking_locations"."location" is not null and "parking_locations"."hourly_rate_minor" is not null)

parking_locations_text_length_check.name: parking_locations_text_length_check
parking_locations_text_length_check.value: ("parking_locations"."name" is null or char_length("parking_locations"."name") between 1 and 120) and ("parking_locations"."address" is null or char_length("parking_locations"."address") between 1 and 200) and ("parking_locations"."description" is null or char_length("parking_locations"."description") <= 2000)

parking_price_rules_night_check.name: parking_price_rules_night_check
parking_price_rules_night_check.value: ("parking_price_rules"."kind" = 'night') = ("parking_price_rules"."from_minute" is not null and "parking_price_rules"."to_minute" is not null) and ("parking_price_rules"."from_minute" is null or ("parking_price_rules"."from_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "parking_price_rules"."to_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "parking_price_rules"."from_minute" <> "parking_price_rules"."to_minute"))

parking_price_rules_dated_check.name: parking_price_rules_dated_check
parking_price_rules_dated_check.value: ("parking_price_rules"."kind" = 'dated') = ("parking_price_rules"."starts_on" is not null and "parking_price_rules"."ends_on" is not null) and ("parking_price_rules"."starts_on" is null or "parking_price_rules"."starts_on" <= "parking_price_rules"."ends_on")
